176:     Public Sub pubStopingTransportIntake()
177: 
178:         Try
179: 
180:             If giStoppingIntakeCount > 0 Then
181:                 Exit Sub
182:             End If
183: 
184:             giStoppingIntakeCount += 1
185: 
186:             Dim sSql As String
187:             Dim eData As New DtBase(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture)
188:             Dim eDataTransport As New DtBase(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture)
189:             eData.Connect()
190: 
191:             'Verifica se a rota está aguardando para contar o tempo de parada
192:             sSql = " Select i.cd_intake, i.cd_transport, i.cd_silo, i.nr_production, i.cd_Unit, " & _
193:                    " isnull(i.cd_silo_alt, 0) cd_silo_alt, isnull(i.cd_transport_alt,0) cd_transport_alt, i.cd_product, i.tp_status " & _
194:                    " from intake i, TRA_Road r " & _
195:                    " where i.cd_transport = r.cd_road " & _
196:                    " and i.cd_transport > 0 " & _
197:                    " and (i.tp_status = 'P' or i.tp_status = 'H' or i.tp_status = 'A') "
198: 
199:             Using eDataReader As SqlDataReader = eData.SelectData(sSql)
200: 
201:                 Dim iEquipment(1000) As Integer
202:                 Dim iEquipmentEmptyTime(1000) As Integer
203:                 Dim iStoppingTime As Integer
204: 
205:                 'Só executa se retornar algum registro
206:                 If eDataReader.HasRows Then
207: 
208:                     Dim sStatus As String
209:                     Dim sDestinationAlt As String
210:                     Dim iIntakeCode As Integer
211:                     Dim sRoadCode As String
212:                     Dim sUnit As String
213:                     Dim iDestination As Integer
214:                     Dim sRoadAltCode As String
215:                     Dim sProduction As String
216:                     Dim sProduct As String
217:                     Dim sDestination As String
218: 
219:                     While eDataReader.Read
220: 
221:                         sStatus = CStr(eDataReader("tp_status"))
222:                         sDestinationAlt = CStr(eDataReader("cd_silo_alt"))
223: 
224:                         Dim eTransports As New Transp(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture, 0)
225:                         Dim sTransition As Integer = CInt(eDataTransport.GetSelectData("select tp_transition from TRA_Source where cd_unit = " & CStr(eDataReader("cd_unit"))))
226: 
227:                         Dim iAltRoad As Integer
228:                         If eTransports.CheckChangeOnTheFlyAlt(CStr(eDataReader("cd_transport")), CStr(eDataReader("cd_transport_alt"))) Then
229:                             iAltRoad = CStr(eDataReader("cd_transport_alt"))
230:                         Else
231:                             iAltRoad = 0
232:                         End If
233: 
234:                         'Se estiver parando ou em nível alto
235:                         If sStatus = "P" OrElse sStatus = "H" Then
236: 
237:                             iIntakeCode = CInt(eDataReader("cd_intake"))
238:                             sRoadCode = CStr(eDataReader("cd_transport"))
239:                             sUnit = CStr(eDataReader("cd_unit"))
240:                             iDestination = CInt(eDataReader("cd_silo"))
241: 
242:                             'Se o status do comando do transporte for aguardando e a posição do transporte for vazia
243:                             'carrega o número do transporte   
244:                             If gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 0) = 0 Then
245: 
246:                                 gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 0) = iIntakeCode
247: 
248:                                 If iAltRoad > 0 AndAlso (Not priRoadHighLevel(sUnit, iAltRoad, CStr(eDataReader("cd_product")))) Then
249:                                     iAltRoad = 0
250:                                 End If
251: 
252:                                 If sStatus = "H" AndAlso sTransition = 2 AndAlso iAltRoad <> 0 AndAlso eTransports.RoadEquipmentStatus(iAltRoad) Then
253:                                     gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 1) = CInt(eDataTransport.GetSelectData("Select vl_highlevel_time from TRA_Road where cd_road = " & sRoadCode))
254:                                 Else
255:                                     gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 1) = CInt(eDataTransport.GetSelectData("Select vl_time_transport from TRA_Road where cd_road = " & sRoadCode))
256:                                 End If
257: 
258:                                 'Seta a word de status do recebimento no clp para parando
259:                                 Dim eIntakeBuffer As New Transports.IntakeBuffer(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture)
260:                                 'Se tiver balança de fluxo
261:                                 If eIntakeBuffer.IntakeBuffer(CStr(iIntakeCode)) Then
262:                                     eIntakeBuffer.UpdatePLCIntakeStatus(iIntakeCode, 2)
263:                                 End If
264: 
265:                             Else 'Se a posição do transporte já estiver preenchida
266: 
267:                                 'Se o valor acumulado da contagem na posição do transporte for maior ou igual 
268:                                 'ao tempo de esvaziamento da rota
269:                                 If gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 1) <= 0 Then
270: 
271:                                     'Se a rota estiver em alarme de nível alto
272:                                     If sStatus = "H" Then
273: 
274:                                         tmrStoppingIntake.Interval = 3600000
275: 
276:                                         sRoadAltCode = eDataReader("cd_transport_alt").ToString
277: 
278:                                         'Zera os valores da posição do transporte
279:                                         gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 0) = 0
280:                                         gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 1) = 0
281: 
282:                                         sProduction = CStr(eDataReader("nr_production"))
283:                                         sProduct = CStr(eDataReader("cd_product"))
284: 
285:                                         'Atualiza ordem de recebimento e estoque para nível alto sem silo alternativo
286:                                         priHighLevel(iIntakeCode.ToString, sProduction, sUnit, sProduct, CStr(iDestination), sDestinationAlt, sStatus, sRoadCode, sRoadAltCode)
287: 
288:                                         tmrStoppingIntake.Interval = 1000
289: 
290:                                     Else 'Se não estiver em nível alto
291: 
292:                                         tmrStoppingIntake.Interval = 3600000
293: 
294:                                         sProduction = CStr(eDataReader("nr_production"))
295:                                         sProduct = CStr(eDataReader("cd_product"))
296: 
297:                                         Dim eIntakeBuffer As New IntakeBuffer(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture)
298:                                         'Se tiver balança de fluxo
299:                                         If eIntakeBuffer.IntakeBuffer(CStr(iIntakeCode)) Then
300: 
301:                                             eIntakeBuffer.UpdateStockIntakeBuffer(CStr(iIntakeCode), eTransports.GetDestinationSilo(CStr(iDestination)), sProduction, CInt(sProduct), priDeliveryWeight(iIntakeCode))
302: 
303:                                         End If
304: 
305:                                         'Envia os comandos para parar os equipamentos da rota
306:                                         eTransports.ImediateStopTransport(sRoadCode)
307: 
308:                                         'Se tiver balança de fluxo
309:                                         If eIntakeBuffer.IntakeBuffer(CStr(iIntakeCode)) Then
310:                                             'Resseta a word de status do recebimento no clp
311:                                             eIntakeBuffer.UpdatePLCIntakeStatus(iIntakeCode, 0)
312:                                         End If
313: 
314:                                         'Apaga os alarmes desta Unit caso haja algum
315:                                         Alarm.DeleteAlarm(0, 3000 + CInt(sUnit))
316: 
317:                                         'Zera os valores da posição do transporte
318:                                         gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 0) = 0
319:                                         gaiStoppingTransport(CInt(sRoadCode), 1) = 0
320: 
321:                                         'Envia posição para o CLP
322:                                         pubSendUnitPosition(sUnit, 0)
323:                                         eTransports.ClearIntake(CStr(iIntakeCode), sUnit)
324: 
325:                                         'Envia os valores de pv e sp dos tempos dos transportes
326:                                         pubSendTransportTime(sUnit, 0)
327: 
328:                                         tmrStoppingIntake.Interval = 1000
329: 
330:                                     End If

164:     Public Sub pubTransportUpdateSiloTransfer()
165: 
166:         Try
167: 
168:             If giSiloTransferUpdateCount > 0 Then
169:                 Exit Sub
170:             End If
171: 
172:             giSiloTransferUpdateCount += 1
173: 
174:             Dim iInterval As Integer = CInt(tmrSiloTransferUpdate.Interval)
175: 
176:             tmrSiloTransferUpdate.Interval = 3600000
177: 
178:             Dim eData As New DtBase(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture)
179:             eData.Connect()
180:             Dim sSql As String
181: 
182:             'Recupera dados da transilagem
183:             sSql = "Select st.cd_silo_transfer, isnull(s.vl_stock_flow, 0) as vl_stock_flow, t.ps_stock_delivered, " & _
184:                    "(Select si.nr_silo from silo si where si.cd_silo = t.cd_source_silo) as cd_source_silo, " & _
185:                    "st.cd_transport, s.ps_stock as ps_stock, st.nr_production, st.cd_destination_silo, " & _
186:                    "s.cd_product, st.ps_enter_stock, st.cd_unit, st.nm_silo_transfer " & _
187:                    "From Silo s, Silo_Transfer_Reg t, Silo_Transfer st " & _
188:                    "Where t.cd_source_silo = s.cd_silo " & _
189:                    "and st.nr_production = t.nr_production " & _
190:                    "and s.vl_stock_flow > 0 " & _
191:                    "And Exists (SELECT si.cd_silo FROM silo si, product p, TRA_Road_Destination_Silo d  " & _
192:                    "            WHERE d.cd_road_destination = st.cd_destination_silo " & _
193:                    "            and si.cd_silo = d.cd_silo " & _
194:                    "            And si.cd_product = p.cd_product " & _
195:                    "            And si.ps_stock < (si.vl_capacity * p.vl_density)) " & _
196:                    "And st.tp_status = 'S' "
197: 
198:             Using eDataReader As SqlDataReader = eData.SelectData(sSql)
199: 
200:                 'Se retornar algum registro
201:                 If eDataReader.HasRows Then
202: 
203:                     While eDataReader.Read
204: 
205:                         Dim iSiloTransferCode As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("cd_silo_transfer"))
206:                         Dim dCalculatedStock As Decimal = CDec(eDataReader("vl_stock_flow"))
207:                         Dim dDeliveredStock As Decimal = CDec(eDataReader("ps_stock_delivered"))
208:                         Dim iCodeSourceSilo As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("cd_source_silo"))
209:                         Dim iRoadCode As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("cd_transport"))
210:                         Dim dSiloInitialStock As Decimal = CDec(eDataReader("ps_stock"))
211:                         Dim iProductionNumber As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("nr_production"))
212:                         Dim sDestination As String = CStr(eDataReader("cd_destination_silo"))
213:                         Dim iProduct As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("cd_product"))
214:                         Dim dEnterStock As Decimal = CInt(eDataReader("ps_enter_stock"))
215:                         Dim sUnit As Integer = CInt(eDataReader("cd_unit"))
216:                         Dim sSiloTransferName As String = CStr(eDataReader("nm_silo_transfer"))
217: 
218:                         'Se estiver atualizando estoque pela balança de fluxo não deve atualizar pelo fluxo do silo para não duplicar
219:                         If priFlowWeigherSiloTransfer(sUnit) Then
220:                             Continue While
221:                         End If
222: 
223:                         Dim eTransports As New Transp(gsDataBaseFile, gsCulture, 0)
224: 
225:                         'Carrega a lista dos silos de destino
226:                         Dim eDestinationSilo As New ArrayList
227:                         eDestinationSilo = eTransports.DestinationSilo(CStr(iRoadCode), True)
228: 
229:                         'Ajusta o número de casas decimais do valor transportado
230:                         dCalculatedStock = Decimal.Round(dCalculatedStock / 2, 2)
231: 
232:                         Dim dSourceStockDifference As Decimal = CDec(eData.GetSelectData("Select ps_stock from silo where cd_silo = " & iCodeSourceSilo.ToString))
233:                         Dim sSqlIntake As String
234: 
235:                         'eData.Connect()
236:                         ''verifica se existe recebimento para o silo de origem da transilagem.
237:                         sSqlIntake = "select isnull(i.ps_quantity, 0) ps_quantity, i.nr_production, st.cd_source_silo, i.cd_silo from Silo_Transfer st " & _
238:                                      "inner join Intake i on i.cd_silo in (Select cd_road_destination from TRA_Road_Destination_Silo where cd_silo = st.cd_source_silo) " & _
239:                                      "and i.tp_status = 'S'"
240: 
241:                         'soma o peso da nota de um possivel recebimento como estoque da transilagem.
242:                         Dim sNegativ = dSourceStockDifference
243: 
244:                         'se existe deixa colocar estoque negativo
245:                         If Not eData.HasRows(sSqlIntake) Then
246:                             'verifica se ja a quantidade a transferir passou o peso da nóta do recebimento.
247:                             If sNegativ > dCalculatedStock Then
248:                                 If dSourceStockDifference < dCalculatedStock Then
249:                                     dCalculatedStock = dSourceStockDifference
250:                                 End If
251:                             Else
252:                                 dCalculatedStock = sNegativ
253:                             End If
254:                         End If
